title: Charnon - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Charnon in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Charnon is a void-element weapon used by Sciel. It scales with Defense (D), Luck (C).

sections.title: How to Get the Charnon
sections.content:
Location: Renoir's Drafts - merchant Grour.

sections.title: Is the Charnon Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Defense (D), Luck (C). A dedicated void pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
